intro: Rwanda's economy has grown rapidly through farming, tourism and services.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Coffee and tea grow on the hills. Gorilla tourism and conferences bring visitors, and Kigali aims to be a tech and finance hub. Drones deliver blood to hospitals.

chapters.title: Minerals
text: Rwanda exports tin, tantalum and tungsten.
